requirements.quote: Actively and affirmatively solicit bids for contracts and subcontracts from qualified State certified MBEs or WBEs, including solicitations to M/WBE contractor associations.
requirements.text: Solicit bids from State-certified M/WBEs and contractor associations.

requirements.quote: Request a list of State-certified M/WBEs from SRAA and solicit bids from them directly.
requirements.text: Obtain and solicit bids from SRAA-certified M/WBEs.

requirements.quote: Ensure that plans, specifications, request for proposals and other documents used to secure bids will be made available in sufficient time for review by prospective M/WBEs.
requirements.text: Provide bid documents to M/WBEs in a timely manner.

requirements.quote: Where feasible, divide the work into smaller portions to increase participation by M/WBEs and encourage the formation of joint ventures and other partnerships among M/WBE contractors to encourage their participation.
requirements.text: Divide work to increase M/WBE participation and encourage partnerships.

requirements.quote: Document and maintain records of bid solicitation, including those to M/WBEs and the results thereof.
requirements.text: Keep records of bid solicitations and results.

requirements.quote: Ensure that project payments to M/WBEs are made on a timely basis so that undue financial hardship is avoided.
requirements.text: Make timely payments to M/WBEs to prevent financial hardship.

requirements.quote: Include the provisions of sections (1) through (6) of this agreement in every subcontract in such a manner that the requirements of the subdivisions will be binding upon each subcontractor as to work in connection with the State contract.
requirements.text: Ensure subcontractors comply with M/WBE provisions.

requirements.quote: This organization will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, religion/creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, military status predisposing genetic characteristics, victim of domestic violence status, or marital status.

State in all solicitation or advertisements for employees that in the performance of the State contract all qualified applicants will be afforded equal employment opportunities without discrimination.
requirements.text: Advertise equal employment opportunities in solicitations.

requirements.quote: Request that each employment agency, labor union, or authorized representative will not discriminate and will affirmatively cooperate in the implementation of this organization’s obligations.
requirements.text: Ensure employment agencies and unions cooperate with EEO policies.

requirements.quote: Include the provisions of sections (a) through (c) of this agreement in every subcontract in such a manner that the requirements of the subdivisions will be binding upon each subcontractor as to work in connection with the State contract.
requirements.text: Ensure subcontractors comply with EEO provisions.
